I posted this in a comment in /v/Atkoism and it was suggested that I share it here. I hope you'll enjoy it, it was only written for a bit of fun! Anyway here it is :D

It was a dark time in the history of our people. Some of us had migrated before but for others like me it was a new and daunting experience. The mother country had treated us well, for a while. We had shared stories, taught each other new skills and made one another laugh but little did we know that there was an invisible hand pulling the strings.

At first the stories were few, always in dark avenues where the majorities fear to tread and the locals are ridiculed by the population at large. Some of the locals decided that everybody should know when the Enforcers exiled them from the land, even though they had broken no laws. This is when I knew that the stories were true. Our overlord, Chairman Pao, was a tyrant. We were taught that we lived in a democracy but it became clear that our home was becoming an SJW dictatorship.

There was a light of hope shining through the void though. A grizzled wanderer had seen a new land and risked having his tongue cut out by the Enforcers to tell us of it. A new land where one could speak freely without fear and there was no oppressive Chairman, rather a mysterious Creator who had made various pledges to protect his people from rogue Enforcers. I had to see for myself.

I left in the night, not even taking my passport, and made the journey. I gave a false name to the immigration officer in preparation for making a clean start and had a look around at my new home. At first it felt like a one horse town. I felt like I had just come from a bustling metropolis to a small quaint place with strange rules and customs but I decided to stick around and give it a chance. Sure, the pace was a little bit pedestrian compared with where I'd come from but the people seemed nicer and willing to discuss ideas rationally. This just might be the place, I thought.

After a while I had gotten to grips with the customs of my new surroundings, but I had a minor issue. I would have to address the Creator. I went to the Creator's court, where all are welcome to make suggestions for the good of the realm. I made my case and a few others spoke in my support. Then he arrived, preceded by an image of his name. He promised before one and all that he would address the issues I raised, which he did within hours. It was then that I knew that I had found my new leader. The Creator. Atko.

  2. Derive down votes available from the user's contribution. ( IE, you quit contributing, eventually you can't down vote )
